Preserve declared valueType across the existing record source/export projection; validate aliases and optional arguments with recordReferenceSemantic; register qualified optional field projections.

repair: The early record pass could not know the qualified scrutinee type and omitted the some-binder. Retain deferred qualified binder identity for the existing Module owner to check exact nominal type and optionality.

name: Geometry collection record-field cardinality producer absent
repair: Geometry literals were dropped at the scalar element-type guard even though field length consumers referenced their contents descriptor. Emit only ordinal cardinality/order; geometry targets remain in the geometry runtime.

name: Selected geometry fields of optional/control-flow records
repair: Field alias lookup discarded if/match/none. Preserve the defining record occurrence and emit existing field geometry programs with reference/none leaves and remapped optional presence. The existing TS geometry/controller environments and Rust graph-controller adapter also need their canonical document optional-member lookups to activate these dependencies.

name: Module-local geometry collection record member resolved in consumer context
repair: After following a qualified record export, its geometry collection member was resolved at root currentPath instead of the defining fieldContextPath. Reuse the already-resolved field owner path.
